scope: Shared icon semantics across the current OneSpace routes; source inventory and disposable-origin browser checks
changes: The note pin control now uses a pushpin glyph, matching its pin/unpin action instead of the previous map-location glyph.
The countdown delete control now uses the shared trash SVG rather than a Unicode multiplication sign.
Shortcut reorder menu actions now use the shared arrow-up and arrow-down glyphs, matching category and trip reorder controls; obsolete rotated-chevron styling was removed.
browserChecks: On Quick Notes, added a disposable test note and reloaded current source. Pin note rendered a pushpin SVG with aria-hidden=true and the accessible name Pin note.
On Productivity, added a disposable countdown. Delete countdown rendered the shared trash SVG with aria-hidden=true and an item-specific accessible name.
On Shortcuts, opened the GitHub More actions menu. Move earlier and Move later rendered shared arrow-up and arrow-down SVGs with explicit text labels.

actionSemantics.add: Shared plus outline or explicit text-labelled Add action
actionSemantics.remove: Shared trash outline or explicit text-labelled Remove action
actionSemantics.favorite: Heart or star depending on domain-specific saved/favorite semantics, with accessible state
actionSemantics.filter: Filter outline or chevron disclosure alongside text
actionSemantics.sort: Directional arrow or explicit text-labelled sort control
actionSemantics.saveRestore: Explicit text labels in Settings and dialogs
actionSemantics.openNavigation: Arrow or menu icon with accessible name

exceptions: Provider/brand marks, favicons, and decorative scene artwork retain their own visual identity; text-labelled actions need no forced icon.
